verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own docs say its Cloud APIs can be used 'with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages', which describes official SDKs for building against the platform. The 'Cloud SDK' install pages back this up, though they cover the gcloud CLI rather than language libraries. missing for 10: a named list of supported languages and per-language library docs, any detail on SDK features or maturity, and independent or hands-on confirmation of building with the client libraries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
